abilities.effect: Fires a lotus_seed projectile (20 damage) along current turret facing; 3-phase anticipation/lunge/settle animation.
abilities.name: Lotus Seed Shot
abilities.trigger: Enemy inside 14 m forward cone, aimed within 5°

clipAnnotations.attack: 3-phase attack: inhale squash → forward lunge (projectile spawns at apex) → elastic settle.
clipAnnotations.idle: Idle breathing when no target in cone.

mechanism: Turret defender. Scans for the nearest enemy inside a 14 m / 22.5° forward cone every 0.1 s, yaws toward it at 180°/s, and fires every 1.5 s once aimed within 5°. Returns to its placed facing when idle. First shot is ready immediately on acquiring a target.
name: Lotus Shooter
subtitle: Seed-Shooting Lotus
